purpose: Minimum data-quality contract before any source can enter a formal JNU research family.

requirements: No mixed grains in one analytical table
Execution/trade date distinguished from exchange trading date where relevant
No future timestamp relative to decision time
Missing-source semantics documented (zero vs missing vs holiday)
No silent forward fill across unknown source gaps
Stale source cannot silently satisfy current-analysis request
Matched expiry where same-underlying venues are compared
Return intervals aligned in UTC after local calendar mapping
Join coverage and dropped-row rate reported
Paid source requires explicit user authorization
Personally licensed raw data is not uploaded when terms prohibit it

automated_tests.rule: A formal family may not report statistical PASS when any CRITICAL data-quality check is unresolved.

current_known_examples.issue: At least one calendar date omitted in cached TimelineTone chunk.
current_known_examples.remediation: G1_DI1 explicit calendar grid; missing remains NaN; no forward fill; common family sample.

current_known_examples.issue: Quality high but paid under current access route.
Personally licensed raw data; exact public schema not verified.
current_known_examples.remediation: Raw local-only, parser requires authorized exact sample/schema.

current_known_examples.issue: Venue/contract identity insufficient for formal price-discovery promotion.
